definitions.complete: Declared source inventories and discovered in-scope links are exhausted; not a claim about unlinked pages or the entire UBC web.
definitions.unavailable: Advertised URL is unavailable after bounded retries, or blocked by access/robots restrictions; the inventory records the reason.
definitions.no_prose: No explanatory body remained in the retrieved representation; interactive-only material is not reconstructed.
definitions.mirror: Coverage refers to the existing mirrored article inventory, with its original timestamps; missing bodies may be fetched from their public pages.
